aboutSection.heading: About Our Hospital
aboutSection.description: Welcome to [Hospital Name], where expert surgical skill meets compassionate patient care. Led by a highly experienced General Surgeon and Gynecologist, our hospital is committed to providing advanced, evidence-based treatments in a comfortable and safe environment. From routine consultations to complex surgeries, we are here for every step of your health journey.

services.title: Laparoscopic Surgery
services.description: Minimally invasive surgical procedures with faster recovery, smaller incisions, and reduced post-operative pain. Suitable for gallbladder, hernia, appendix, and more.

services.title: General Surgery
services.description: Comprehensive surgical care for abdominal, digestive, and soft tissue conditions. From diagnosis to post-operative recovery, we ensure complete care.

services.title: Gynecology Consultation
services.description: Expert evaluation and treatment for all women's health concerns including menstrual disorders, PCOS, infections, and hormonal imbalances.

services.title: Obstetrics & Maternity
services.description: Complete prenatal, antenatal, and postnatal care for expecting mothers. Safe delivery options with expert monitoring throughout the pregnancy journey.

services.title: PCOD / PCOS Treatment
services.description: Personalised treatment plans for Polycystic Ovarian Disease including hormonal therapy, lifestyle guidance, and surgical options when required.

services.title: Gallbladder Surgery
services.description: Laparoscopic cholecystectomy (gallbladder removal) performed with precision and care, ensuring minimal recovery time and maximum patient comfort.

services.title: Hernia Surgery
services.description: Advanced hernia repair using laparoscopic techniques for inguinal, umbilical, and incisional hernias. Quick recovery with lasting results.

services.title: Fibroid & Ovarian Cyst Removal
services.description: Surgical and non-surgical management of uterine fibroids and ovarian cysts through laparoscopic myomectomy and cystectomy procedures.

services.title: Hysterectomy
services.description: Total or partial removal of the uterus performed laparoscopically or open, depending on the patient's condition. Expert counselling provided before and after.

services.title: Appendix Surgery
services.description: Emergency and elective appendectomy using laparoscopic methods, ensuring fast recovery and minimal scarring.

services.title: Women's Health Checkup
services.description: Routine wellness exams including Pap smear, breast examination, pelvic ultrasound, and hormonal profiling for proactive women's health management.

services.title: Emergency Surgery
services.description: Round-the-clock surgical emergency services for acute abdominal conditions, trauma, and urgent gynecological complications.

points.title: Experienced Specialists
points.description: Our surgeon and gynecologist bring years of expertise in their respective fields with hundreds of successful procedures.

points.title: Advanced Laparoscopic Equipment
points.description: We use the latest minimally invasive surgical tools to ensure precision, faster recovery, and minimal discomfort.

points.title: Patient-First Approach
points.description: Every patient receives a personalised treatment plan with transparent communication, honest pricing, and compassionate follow-up care.

points.title: Comprehensive Care Under One Roof
points.description: From initial consultation to surgery, recovery, and follow-up — everything is handled within our hospital for your convenience.

faqs.question: What conditions does the General Surgeon treat?
faqs.answer: Our General Surgeon handles conditions like gallstones, hernias, appendicitis, thyroid lumps, soft tissue masses, and abdominal emergencies among others.

faqs.question: Is laparoscopic surgery safe?
faqs.answer: Yes, laparoscopic (keyhole) surgery is very safe. It involves smaller incisions, less bleeding, lower infection risk, and faster recovery compared to open surgery.

faqs.question: What does the Gynecologist treat?
faqs.answer: Our Gynecologist handles PCOS, irregular periods, fibroids, ovarian cysts, pregnancy care, menopause management, and routine women's health checkups.

faqs.question: Do I need a referral to book an appointment?
faqs.answer: No referral is needed. You can directly book an appointment with either of our doctors for a consultation.

faqs.question: Does the hospital offer emergency surgical services?
faqs.answer: Yes, we provide 24/7 emergency surgical care for acute conditions. Please call our helpline immediately in case of an emergency.

faqs.question: How long is the recovery after laparoscopic surgery?
faqs.answer: Most patients recover within 3–7 days for laparoscopic procedures, compared to 2–4 weeks for open surgery, depending on the specific procedure.

faqs.question: Is pregnancy care available at this hospital?
faqs.answer: Yes, our Gynecologist provides complete antenatal, delivery, and postnatal care for expecting mothers.
